entities.name: Iona
entities.description: One of the greater archangels of Zendikar who resisted the Eldrazi and defended Zendikar during their last awakening.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Interplanar monstrosities that left their mark on the angels.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The place Iona descended from to battle the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan tied to a distorted vision of Iona's epithet.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group that battled the Eldrazi titans.

events.summary: Iona defended Zendikar during the last awakening of the Eldrazi, but her power could not fend off the colorless magic of the titans.
events.quote: She defended Zendikar during the last awakening of the Eldrazi

events.summary: Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, leaving the Sky Ruin unguarded, and did not return after Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed.
events.quote: When Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, she left the Sky Ruin unguarded.

relations.quote: She defended Zendikar during the last awakening of the Eldrazi
